business:
Twist Bioscience Corporation provides customizable solutions across the biological continuum, helping customers read, write and innovate in biology. Across diagnostics, therapeutics, industrial, agriculture and research markets, our customers use our products and services to develop ways to improve human health and the sustainability of the planet. Our goal is to enable them to do this work with confidence, without having to compromise on quality, speed, scale or cost. We believe that the faster our customers succeed, the better for all of us.
At the core of our business is a proprietary platform that allows us to manufacture synthetic DNA by “writing” DNA on a silicon chip. We have miniaturized traditional chemical DNA synthesis reactions to write over 1,000,000 pieces of DNA (oligonucleotides) up to 500 bases through direct synthesis on each silicon chip, approximately the size of a large mobile phone, reducing the amount of chemicals by 99.8% compared to plate-based synthesis. We have combined our silicon-based DNA writing technology with proprietary software, scalable commercial infrastructure and an e-commerce platform to create an integrated technology platform that enables us to achieve high levels of quality, precision, automation and manufacturing throughput at a lower cost relative to legacy methods. Because our platform writes millions of unique sequences in parallel, we can build products to customers' specification at scale.
Building from this platform, we serve customers through two product groups. Through DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions, we offer end-to-end solutions for therapeutic drug discovery including DNA synthesis, protein expression, antibody characterization and biologics discovery solutions. Through NGS Applications, we provide tools used between the sample and the sequencer including target enrichment panels and library preparation kits. Both product lines start with DNA written on our silicon platform. Our products and services are designed to enable customers to run more experiments and iterations with the same resources, giving them more opportunities for success. We sell our products and services to a global customer base of approximately 4,100 customers across a broad range of industries.
We believe our products and services enable a broad range of customers including applications that may ultimately improve health and the sustainability of the planet across multiple industries, including:
• therapeutics, to discover new biologic drugs that treat a wide range of diseases;
• diagnostics, to detect and monitor disease and guide treatment decisions, including in cancer and inherited and rare disease;
• industry and applied markets, including enzyme engineering and the cost-effective and sustainable production of new and existing specialty chemicals and materials, such as spider silk, nylon, rubber, fragrances, food flavors and food additives;
• agriculture, for more effective and sustainable crop production; and
• academic research and government, for a broad range of education and discovery applications.
Background
We generate revenue from our two product groups: DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions and NGS Applications. Beginning in fiscal 2026, we combined our synthetic biology products and biopharma services for antibody discovery into DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions, as more customers use both together, and renamed NGS tools as NGS Applications to reflect their role in sequencing workflows. In addition, we are leveraging our platform to expand our portfolio to include other products and services to address additional market opportunities.
In fiscal year 2026, we served approximately 4,100 customers and reported $459.4 million in revenue, including $162.3 million in revenue from therapeutics, $164.3 million in revenue from diagnostics, $56.6 million in revenue from academic research and government, $52.0 million in revenue from global supply partners and $24.2 million in revenue from industry and applied.

Our Markets
Our next-generation sequencing (NGS) applications and DNA synthesis and protein solutions product groups serve large and growing markets. Based on third-party industry reports and our internal estimates, we estimate that by 2030 our combined serviceable addressable market (SAM) across both will exceed $13 billion. We expect our SAM to continue to expand as we introduce new products.
NGS Applications
By 2030, we estimate our SAM for NGS applications will be approximately $6 billion, within a total addressable market (TAM) of more than $90 billion. Our NGS SAM includes approximately:
• $3.6 billion in oncology diagnostics. This covers liquid biopsy for therapy selection, multicancer screening (multicancer early detection and multicancer detection) and molecular residual disease (MRD), plus comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) of tissue;
• $800 million in academic research;
• $500 million in microarray;
• $400 million in rare and inherited disease; and
• $400 million in biotech and pharma research and development.
DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions
By 2030, we estimate our SAM for DNA synthesis and protein solutions will exceed $7 billion, within a TAM of approximately $18 billion. This SAM includes approximately:
• $2.5 billion in antibody discovery services;
• $2.0 billion in DNA synthesis;
• $1.6 billion in protein expression; and
• $1.0 billion in nucleic acid therapeutics.
As of May 2026, we estimated that $1 billion of the DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions SAM comes from artificial intelligence ("AI")-enabled drug discovery, split evenly between antibody discovery services and protein expression. This estimate covers customers building foundational models for antibody discovery and customers using those models to discover antibodies. It assumes no single model becomes dominant for binding prediction or other characterization, so iteration continues. It also assumes the scope of preclinical development work done with these models keeps expanding. Subsequent models for AI drug discovery have estimated the market to be significantly larger.

Our Product Groups
DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions
Our DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions serve life sciences researchers across a variety of healthcare applications including AI drug discovery, traditional drug discovery, enzyme engineering, gene editing and basic academic research. In addition, these products are used for chemical and materials applications including development of synthetic spider silk, nylon, rubber, fragrances, flavors and food additives; for food and agricultural applications including improving crop traits such as adding vitamins or improving drought tolerance, and engineering bacteria to deliver nitrogen at the root of plants. While synthetic DNA has been produced for more than 40 years, the complexities of biology and the production constraints inherent in legacy processes have historically limited the applications and market opportunities for DNA synthesis.
Synthetic DNA is the fundamental building block that allows researchers to engineer biology. Synthetic DNA is a foundational product enabling the entire bioeconomy. The National Security Commission on Emerging Biotechnology recognized synthetic DNA as a critical choke point in many supply chains, making broad access important for many industries. In addition to synthetic DNA, we offer RNA products, expressed proteins and characterization data that support customers through the design-build-test-learn cycle. Customers can work with us at any point in that cycle, from ordering gene fragments to run their own experiments to having us manage the full workflow of DNA synthesis, gene construction, protein expression and characterization.
We see increasingly more revenue from DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions supporting AI drug discovery. Customers use AI to design antibodies and other proteins and generate candidate sequences computationally. Those sequences are then sent to Twist for build and test in our lab. Demand from these customers grew substantially in fiscal 2026 as we have become a protein and data partner as well as a DNA supplier.
NGS Applications
Our NGS Applications products help customers read DNA. They play an integral role in the way our customers prepare their samples to be sequenced. NGS has transformed many markets in recent years by changing the landscape of diagnosing disease and disorders and offers a path to prevent or treat disease.
